Anthropic.trains_by_default: Anthropic says Free, Pro, and Max chats are used for training only if you allow it, and you choose at signup. The toggle has been reported as on by default, so check it.
Anthropic.opt_out: Settings, then Privacy. Turn off Help improve Claude.

OpenAI.trains_by_default: Yes on personal Free, Plus, and Pro. Improve the model for everyone is on by default.
OpenAI.opt_out: Settings, Data controls, turn off Improve the model for everyone.

Google.trains_by_default: Yes for adults. Gemini History is on by default, and those chats can be used to train Google's generative AI. Human reviewers may read some chats.
Google.opt_out: In Gemini History (myactivity.google.com/product/gemini), turn off training or History. Chats are still kept about 2 months; reviewed chats up to 3 years.

Moonshot AI.trains_by_default: Yes. The Kimi consumer policy says prompts and files can be used to improve models.
Moonshot AI.opt_out: Ask Kimi support to stop training use if the app has no toggle.

Xiaomi.trains_by_default: No, if you download the open weights and run them yourself. Xiaomi publishes no training terms for its hosted MiMo Studio and API that we could find.
Xiaomi.opt_out: Run the open weights on your own machine when chats must stay private.

DeepSeek.trains_by_default: Possibly. DeepSeek says some optimization data can come from user input, after de-identification.
DeepSeek.opt_out: Use the opt-out described in the DeepSeek privacy policy.
